mode: Same-assistant tabletop walkthrough of Case A using the seven pinned specialist responsibilities and existing TW6-TW9 evidence. Human classroom execution, seven independent calls, field trial and TW11 integrated execution are not claimed.

intake.emerging_technology: Bounded agentic AI uses a model to choose permitted tools, observe results and continue a supervised digital task.
intake.intended_application: Read-only review of charts against source tables and draft discrepancy notes. No write or publication.
intake.organization: Fictional mid-sized US financial-services reporting unit
intake.industry_sector: Financial services and internal management reporting
intake.business_need: Reduce review effort without losing accuracy or traceability
intake.users_stakeholders: Analysts, reporting lead, data and security authority, and management
intake.capabilities_constraints: Analysts and deterministic checks available; proposed external data/tool route expressly unapproved. Eligible tenant and protected cover unknown.
intake.risk_consequence_context: Material wrong denominator, filter or period; private-data exposure and erroneous report reliance.
intake.management_question: Should management start the proposed chart review trial now or take a less committal step?
intake.time_horizon: 2026-11-24 plus 30 days for a planning reassessment
intake.additional_context: Constructed input C-A. Evidence snapshot SD-TW10-D1. No client data, models, external tools or production systems invoked.

slots.application: Deterministic checks can still handle explicit reconciliation rules.
slots.organization: Mechanism explains a candidate design, not a permitted data route.

slots.organization: No evidence of material change to this firm's business model or complete review cost.

slots.general: A transformative classification requires qualifying evidence.
slots.application: An assistance workflow alone does not establish removal of a categorical barrier.
slots.organization: Withhold Promethean assignment; this does not prevent comparing bounded learning options.

slots.general: General adoption indicators do not establish diffusion for an exact task.
slots.application: No chart-agent use definition and peer denominator in this packet.
slots.organization: Do not infer peer pressure or permission from general market attention.

source_dispositions.exclude: No inferred tenant eligibility, actual retirement date, chart reliability or operating clearance.

challenge_and_retest.nature: Deliberately injected design counterexample, then a manually traced correction; neither is a model-produced failure transcript.
challenge_and_retest.injected_candidate: Recommend a proof of concept now because a newly announced BI feature and a software-duration graph look promising; the positive reviewer can accept it.
challenge_and_retest.caught: A1: feature/benchmark scope mismatch. A4/A7: readiness and route prohibit the trial, and accepting advice cannot create permission.
challenge_and_retest.revision: Make scope-checked authorization and stage readiness a pre-composition gate. Preserve raw proposal as a rejected alternative, constrain the final primary action, and independently recheck final text after synthesis.
challenge_and_retest.retest: Same intake and same claims. Quarantine unsupported upgrade claims. Retain learning opportunity as dissent. Final action DEFER; no movement into a trial; no fabricated human authorization. The tabletop checked reasoning, not implementation enforcement.

management_card.scope: Proposed chart-to-source agent trial in fictional Organization A over next 30 days
management_card.decision_reason: The proposed route is not approved. Protected review and exact tenant remain unverified; outside evidence does not establish local comparative benefit.

findings_by_level.general: Feature availability and software benchmarks are narrow signals.
findings_by_level.application: Chart corrections require exact source row, period, filter, unit and denominator.
findings_by_level.organization: Continue analysts plus validated deterministic checks; no agent execution.

management_card.best_baseline: Analyst plus deterministic reconciliation and human sign-off.
management_card.value_and_risk_tradeoff: Delaying the trial slows learning; unauthorized access and false reporting have greater immediate consequence. Continue bounded paper design, not model processing.

source_map.claim: Microsoft notice warrants feature review only

management_card.confidence_and_gaps: High confidence in supplied route denial; uncertain exact tenant, peer adoption and comparative task performance. Missing local results are not zero value.
management_card.material_dissent: Investigate whether a strictly isolated PoC can speed learning; promoted launch proposal rejected because scope-matched permission and cover are absent.
management_card.conditions_and_stops: Stop at analysis; no private table access, model call with company data or publication. Recheck scoped authority, owner and cover before any later trial recommendation.
management_card.monitoring_owner_signal_review: Proposed BI/data steward and reporting owner: check documented route and traceability on scope change and no later than 2026-12-24. Then re-run readiness and action advice.

report_out.architecture_choice: Deterministic full or focused routing; separately validated readiness and authority; one management recommendation.
report_out.largest_open_conflict: Adoption may see reversible learning value while the exact data/tool or operating-stage approval is unavailable. The missing approval must block that stage, not block all planning.
report_out.most_likely_to_fail: A4: keeping a single clear action while showing scope-mismatched dissent and why it did not prevail. Test a mixed favorable proposal and decisive hard gate.
